This bounded-support expression handles P n=0 by including all positive support indices, since every positive d divides0. For P n!=0 it agrees with the usual sum over (P n).divisors: actual Nat.divisors52 is the finite positive-divisor set, while divisors0 is EMPTY and is expressly NOT used to replace the bounded-support sum at zero. Finset.sum66 supplies actual finite sum; squaring a real sum gives nonnegativity.
